heading: Local Artisans
content: Every cloth is woven by a weaving group in one of our partner villages. We know their names, and you can read them on the label of every piece.

heading: Natural Dyes
content: Indigo, turmeric, noni root and tree bark replace synthetic dyes. The colours are soft, age beautifully, and the run-off is safe for rivers.

heading: Fair Prices
content: Prices are agreed with artisans before the first thread goes on the loom, not squeezed once the cloth is finished. Contracts are long-term, not seasonal.

heading: Made to Last
content: Dense weaves, strong edge finishing and a lifetime repair service. The best cloth is the one you never need to replace in a hurry.
